scenario: Set-aside estimate in the first month of activity, from a projection alone. A new autónomo profesional registers on 15 January, has no employment income, no activity the year before and no former employer among his clients, and invoices only EU business and US clients in VC. He expects to invoice 30,000 over the year with 1,200 of expenses besides his RETA cuota. Nothing has been invoiced yet, so the estimate as of Q1 rests entirely on that projection. Tarifa plana covers the whole year, the month of alta prorated. No activity in 2024 and a positive projected net make this the activity's first positive period, so the profile states NewActivity Started(First) and the annual return takes 20 % off its net (LIRPF art. 32.3); Modelo 130 does not. Modelo 130 collects more than the annual return will want, so the true-up gap is zero and the refund is not counted on.

setAside.oracleRef: Arithmetic under the set-aside estimator's composition rules in #2 (Implementation Decisions) and #10, over sources checked 2026-09-26. Re-derived for #39 on 2026-09-27 by an independent Decimal script, written without reading the engine, which first reproduced every earlier expected value of this golden under the earlier TGSS rule and then changed only that rule. TGSS (#39): LGSS art. 308.1.c 1.ª–3.ª (boe.es consolidated RDL 8/2015, read 2026-09-27): rendimiento computable = IRPF rendimiento neto plus the titular's own cuotas (1.ª), less 7 % gastos genéricos (2.ª, config seguridadSocial.gastosGenericos), spread over the months of alta (3.ª). The net is Modelo 100 casilla 0224 and the cuotas casilla 0186 (AEAT, Información para determinar el rendimiento neto, sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es, page updated 18 Sep 2026, read 2026-09-27); casilla 0224 is after difícil justificación (RD 439/2007 art. 30.2ª: 5 %, at most 2,000) and before every LIRPF art. 32 reduction, which Modelo 100 2025 takes afterwards in casillas 0225–0226 and 0232–0235 (Anexo I, página 9), so the art. 32.3 reduction does not lower it. So previo 30,000 − 1,200 − 925.33 of cuotas = 27,874.67, difícil justificación 1,393.7335, casilla 0224 26,480.9365, plus the 925.33 of cuotas = 27,406.2665, × (1 − 0.07) / 12 = 2,123.99 a month, tramo General 6; tarifa plana 80 under Ley 20/2007 art. 38 ter.1 for the alta month and the twelve after it; January prorated 80 × 17 / 30 = 45.33 under RD 2064/1995 art. 45.1, as worded since Ley 6/2017 (disposición final 2.ª.3), which fixes the divisor at thirty for any of a year's first three altas (RD 84/1996 art. 46.2.a); boe.es consolidated text read 2026-09-27; #37 corrects the earlier LGSS art. 31.2 citation, which in the consolidated LGSS is Interés de demora and never set this rule; the year is 45.33 + 11 × 80 = 925.33 and the highest Q1 month is 80. Modelo 130 (SPEC-003 §1, AEAT instrucciones del modelo 130, casillas 01–19): the projection spread evenly over the twelve months of alta, gastos to date plus the cuotas to date; casilla 02 adds difícil justificación, 5 % of the net to date (RD 439/2007 art. 30.2ª and 110.1.a, #33), so Q1 is 505.33 + 349.7335 = 855.06 and casilla 03 is 6,644.94; 20 % of the cumulative net, minoración 100 a quarter because no activity last year counts as a net of zero (casilla 13, RD 439/2007 art. 110.3.c); Q1 1,228.99 due 1–22 April, Q2 to Q4 1,222.40 each, Σ 4,896.19. Annual: LIRPF art. 30.2.4 difícil justificación 5 % of 27,874.67 = 1,393.7335, net 26,480.9365; LIRPF art. 32.3 (AEAT Manual práctico Renta 2025, cap. 7, fase 3) takes 0.20 × 26,480.9365 = 5,296.1873 off a new activity's first positive period, base 21,184.7492; cuota 1,733.21238 estatal (state mínimo 5,550) + 1,632.719904 VC (VC mínimo 6,105, Ley 13/1997 art. 2 bis) = 3,365.932284 (LIRPF art. 56, 63, 74), below the advances, so the gap is max(0, 3,365.93 − 4,896.19) = 0. Hold-back share (4,896.19 + 0 + 925.33) / 30,000 = 0.194050666…, rounded up to 0.1941. No AEAT simulator or published example covers a set-aside estimate; this is the weakest gate. Added with #15: the gap is payable with Renta 2025, by the end of 2026-06 (config calendar.renta); tarifa plana runs through 2026-01, the alta month plus twelve complete months (Ley 20/2007 art. 38 ter.1, boe.es consolidated text read 2026-09-26), and from 2026-02 the cuota is General 6's 400.20 at the 2025 tramos, so a second SET_ASIDE_ESTIMATE warning announces the step. Due window (#40): RD 439/2007 art. 111.1 and Orden EHA/672/2007 art. 7 give 1–20 of the month, and a last day that is a Saturday, Sunday or holiday of the taxpayer's region moves to the next working day (Orden EHA/672/2007 art. 7; Ley 39/2015 art. 30.5–30.6; boe.es, read 2026-09-27); 20 April 2025 is a Sunday and 21 April Easter Monday, a día inhábil in the Comunitat Valenciana (BOE-A-2024-26935), so the last day is 22 April.
